addons.name: SSL Certificate Setup
addons.description: Full installation and configuration of SSL/TLS certificates for your domain(s). Covers certificate provisioning (Let's Encrypt or commercial CA), server configuration, HTTPS redirect rules, HSTS headers, and mixed-content resolution. Your site goes green across every browser and search engine.
includes: Certificate provisioning (Let's Encrypt or commercial CA)

addons.name: SEO Boost Package
addons.tagline: Show up. Get clicked. Get found.
addons.description: Comprehensive on-page and technical SEO optimization that makes search engines actually understand and rank your site. Covers everything from meta tags and schema markup to Core Web Vitals and crawlability — the fundamentals that agencies charge 10x for.
includes: Technical SEO audit (crawl errors, indexing, sitemap)
Meta title & description optimization for all pages
Image alt text and file name optimization
Core Web Vitals analysis and optimization
Google Search Console setup and submission

addons.name: Analytics Dashboard
addons.description: Custom analytics setup with the tracking that matters to your business — traffic sources, conversion events, user paths, and goal completions. Option for privacy-first analytics (Plausible, Fathom) instead of Google Analytics if you want data without feeding the algorithm.
includes: Analytics platform setup (GA4, Plausible, or Fathom)
Custom event tracking (button clicks, form submits, etc.)
Training session on reading your data

addons.name: Monthly Maintenance Plan
addons.description: A hands-off monthly maintenance retainer that keeps your website secure, up-to-date, and performing. Includes dependency updates, security patches, uptime monitoring, and a monthly health report — so you can focus on your business while someone watches the machines.
includes: Monthly performance and security health report

addons.name: Advanced Contact Forms
addons.description: Custom-built contact and lead capture forms with spam protection, conditional logic, file uploads, and CRM integration. Goes far beyond a basic contact form — think multi-step quote wizards, booking requests, or full intake questionnaires.
includes: CRM integration (HubSpot, Airtable, Notion, or webhook)

addons.name: Performance Optimization
addons.description: A targeted performance audit and optimization sprint to get your site loading in under 2 seconds. Covers everything from image optimization and lazy loading to CDN setup, caching strategies, and code splitting. Every 100ms of load time costs conversions — this pays for itself.
includes: Image compression, WebP conversion, and lazy loading
CDN setup and static asset caching configuration
Critical CSS extraction and render-blocking fix
JavaScript bundle analysis and code splitting
Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID) improvement targeting
